computedRatios.definitionExcerpt: " Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio " shall mean, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) (i) Consolidated EBITDA for the Test Period most recently ended on or prior to such date of determination, less (ii) Consolidated Maintenance Capital Expenditures for such Test Period (other than those financed with long term indebtedness (other than revolving indebtedness)), less (iii) the aggregate amount of federal, state, local and foreign income taxes paid in cash and Tax Distributions (including, for the avoidance of doubt, payments made pursuant to the Tax Receivable Agreement), in each case, of or by the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries during such Test Period, less (iv) Restricted Payments (other than (w) Tax Distributions, (x) any distributions declared, required, committed to be made, or paid on or prior to the Closing Date, (y) any Restricted Payments made in connection with the Transactions (including the initial public offering of Ultimate Parent and the other transactions contemplated thereby), and (z) any distributions or dividends funded with, or made from, the proceeds of any secondary offering of Capital Stock of Holdings (or any direct or indirect parent company thereof))) paid in cash by the Borrower during such Test Period to (b) Fixed Charges of the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries on consolidated basis for such Test Period; provided , that, notwithstanding the foregoing, for purposes of calculating Fixed Charges under clause (b) for the Test Period ending (i) March 31, 2027 shall be Fixed Charges of the Borrower and the Restricted Subsidiaries for the period beginning January 1, 2027 and ending March 31, 2027 multiplied by four, (ii) June 30, 2027 shall be Fixed Charges for the period beginning January 1, 2027 and ending June 30, 2027 multiplied by two, and (iii) September 30, 2027 shall be Fixed Charges for the period beginning January 1, 2027 and ending September 30, 2027 multiplied by 4/3.
computedRatios.note: Definition is cite-bound. Unbound operands: Consolidated EBITDA, Fixed Charges. No proxy was substituted.

computedRatios.ratioKey: DEFINED:Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt to Consolidated EBITDA Ratio
computedRatios.displayName: Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt to Consolidated EBITDA Ratio
computedRatios.definitionExcerpt: " Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt to Consolidated EBITDA Ratio " shall mean, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt as of such date of determination, minus unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents (in each case, free and clear of all Liens other than Permitted Liens) of the Borrower and the Restricted Subsidiaries to (b) Consolidated EBITDA for the Test Period most recently ended on or prior to such date of determination, in each case with such pro forma adjustments to Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt and Consolidated EBITDA as are appropriate and consistent with the pro forma adjustment provisions set forth in the definition of Pro Forma Basis.
computedRatios.note: Definition is cite-bound. Unbound operands: Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt, Cash Equivalents, Consolidated EBITDA. No proxy was substituted.

computedRatios.note: Definition is cite-bound. Unbound operands: Consolidated Senior Secured Debt, Cash Equivalents, Consolidated EBITDA. No proxy was substituted.

computedRatios.definitionExcerpt: " Consolidated Total Debt to Consolidated EBITDA Ratio " shall mean, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (i) Consolidated Total Debt as of such date of determination, minus unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents (in each case, free and clear of all Liens other than Permitted Liens) of the Borrower and the Restricted Subsidiaries as of such date of determination to (ii) Consolidated EBITDA of the Borrower for the Test Period most recently ended on or prior to such date of determination, in each case with such pro forma adjustments to Consolidated Total Debt and Consolidated EBITDA as are appropriate and consistent with the pro forma adjustment provisions set forth in the definition of Pro Forma Basis.
